clue.text: Armada's earlier problem: no sea-trained senior officer aboard

indicators.note: a problem is a puzzle to be worked out, so the letters of the first phrase are to be rearranged
no says the letters of the following word are not part of the result, taken from the pool

explanation.surface: The Spanish Armada's earlier trouble was having no seasoned admiral on board.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle the letters of ARMADA'S EARLIER less the letters of SEA. 'trained' merely joins with 'sea' to make the surface's seasoned sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A rear admiral is a senior naval rank, an officer serving aboard a fleet's ships.

clue.text: Give the candidate another question?

parts.note: setting a candidate a further question is to test them a second time

explanation.definitionFit: To set fresh questions to a candidate is to test them once more, a second examination.

clue.text: Leave to go absent for one who wants to

definitions.text: Leave to go absent for one who wants to

parts.words: Leave to go absent for one who wants to
parts.note: someone who wants to be absent may simply run off secretly without permission

explanation.definitionFit: To flee secretly, slipping away without leave, is to go absent of one's own accord.

clue.text: One in a ring of policemen after Bill for making music

indicators.note: after places the following construction behind the abbreviation for the bill

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill

indicators.note: in puts the numeral for one inside the ring of officers

parts.note: a cordon is a ring of police holding back a crowd
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone stands in a police cordon after an invoice arrives, all to make music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man or a police nickname, but here it is an invoice; 'for making music' describes what the instrument is for.
explanation.definitionFit: The squeezebox is an instrument, a device used for producing music.

clue.text: Bumps into horses, dogs and people!

definitions.meaning: gatherings such as race meetings for horses, coursing events for dogs, or gatherings of people

explanation.surface: A list of who collides with animals and folk.
explanation.definitionFit: To come across someone is to encounter them; as a noun the word also means sporting gatherings.

clue.text: Cold-blooded creature — compel it, perhaps, to go back inside

indicators.note: to go back says the letters found are read from right to left
inside says the letters are lodged within the phrase compel it, perhaps

explanation.surface: A snake-like animal that you might force back into its lair.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside 'compel it, perhaps' sits ELITPER; read backwards it gives the creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Snakes and lizards are ectotherms, whose body heat depends on their surroundings.

clue.text: Sort of paper put on inside cover

definitions.meaning: writing paper ruled with guide rules
given an inner layer, as a coat with a lining

explanation.surface: A stationery item fitted within a folder.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruled writing paper carries this adjective, and a coat with an inner layer is said to have one sewn in.

clue.text: We want shooting if we ground them!

definitions.text: We want shooting if we ground them!

parts.words: We want shooting if we ground them!
parts.note: spoken by things planted in soil, which hope to sprout shoots once put in the earth

explanation.definitionFit: Planted grains sprout shoots once set into the soil, the gardener's hope.

clue.text: Put off by a gunman about to fire

definitions.text: Put off by a gunman about to fire

parts.words: Put off by a gunman about to fire
parts.note: a gunman about to shoot first disengages the device that stops the trigger working

explanation.definitionFit: The locking lever on a firearm is released, switched off, before the weapon is fired.

clue.text: Did it to character standing down as a result

definitions.text: Did it to character standing down as a result

parts.words: Did it to character standing down as a result
parts.note: lowering one's standing or reputation is to debase it

explanation.definitionFit: To debase or lower someone's reputation is to make it worth less, as a fall in standing.

clue.text: Messrs. Drake & Twist, couturiers

indicators.note: twist means wring into another shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A firm of fashion designers called Drake and Twist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twist' looks like a partner's surname; it signals the rearrangement of MESSRS DRAKE.
explanation.definitionFit: Couturiers are fashion designers who make clothes to order, tailoring gowns.

clue.text: A smack in the mouth!

parts.note: smack here means a taste, which is experienced in the mouth, not a blow

explanation.definitionFit: A smack is a distinctive taste, a savour perceived on the tongue.

clue.text: Cheat small inner London district; lend counterfeit order

parts.note: W1 is the postal district of central London, written WI

indicators.note: counterfeit order means a false arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fraud in a central London area involving a forged payment instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: W1 is the postcode district covering London's West End, its 1 read as I. 'counterfeit order' turns LEND into NDLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To con or defraud someone is to cheat them, as a noun also a fraud.

clue.text: Made the effort — was bound to get the king in

indicators.note: in puts the king's letter inside the word for was bound

parts.note: tied means was bound, fastened
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Someone struggled because they were obliged to admit the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Having had a go at something, one has attempted it, put in effort.

clue.text: Makes another person think he's good!

definitions.text: Makes another person think he's good!

parts.words: Makes another person think he's good!
parts.note: winning someone's admiration, so they think well of you

explanation.definitionFit: To win admiration is to make a strong favourable mark on someone.

clue.text: Such a case before him helps judge with case before him

definitions.text: Such a case before him helps judge with case before him

parts.words: Such a case before him helps judge with case before him
parts.note: an earlier case already decided guides a judge deciding the case now in court

explanation.definitionFit: A legal ruling from an earlier case serves as authority for later decisions, guiding courts.

clue.text: Going down after these criminals!

parts.note: criminals go down, slang for go to jail, after a judge passes punishments

explanation.definitionFit: Punishments passed by a court lead convicts to be sent to prison.

clue.text: Go to empty shops for such a sale

definitions.text: Go to empty shops for such a sale

parts.words: Go to empty shops for such a sale
parts.note: a sale held to empty a shop of its stock

explanation.definitionFit: A sale to dispose of all stock, emptying the shelves, is so named.

clue.text: Even a conscript isn't such a soldier .

definitions.text: a conscript isn't such a soldier
definitions.meaning: a professional soldier of the standing army, not a called-up conscript

explanation.surface: Not even a drafted man counts as this type of soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Even means steady or uniform; a professional soldier of the standing army has this title.

clue.text: In the Bible, waste of food? Quite the reverse

definitions.text: In the Bible, waste of food? Quite the reverse

parts.words: In the Bible, waste of food? Quite the reverse
parts.note: waste means wilderness; the biblical item was food of the wilderness, the reverse order of the phrase

explanation.definitionFit: In Exodus the Israelites were fed with heaven-sent bread in the wilderness.

clue.text: Even after such a performance

parts.note: even is short for evening, which follows an afternoon show

explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon theatre show comes before the evening, hence evening follows it.

clue.text: Must succeed, this present day!

parts.note: the coming night necessarily follows the present day

explanation.definitionFit: The night of the present day follows it, coming after daylight, so it succeeds today.

clue.text: Rolls on them!

parts.note: rolls are registers or lists, and what appears on them are people's identities

explanation.definitionFit: A roll is a register, and what is written on it is a list of people's designations.

clue.text: Made in the US by cars with engine using diesel, usually

definitions.text: Made in the US by cars with engine using diesel, usually

parts.words: Made in the US by cars with engine using diesel, usually
parts.note: a line of railway cars, as Americans call carriages, pulled by a locomotive usually diesel-powered

explanation.definitionFit: A railway locomotive hauling coaches, which Americans call cars, forms this vehicle.

clue.text: Not mean old boy friend vandalising meter

parts.note: an ex is a former boyfriend

indicators.note: vandalising means wrecking, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A generous former partner damages the gas meter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vandalising' turns METER into TREME. 'Not mean' plays on mean as average.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean is the middle or average; the outermost value is far from it.

clue.text: If you do it, take pride in your achievement

definitions.text: If you do it, take pride in your achievement

parts.words: If you do it, take pride in your achievement
parts.note: taking the pride out of someone; the phrase take pride is read as remove pride

explanation.definitionFit: To shame someone is to strip away their dignity and self-respect.

clue.text: Cuts and pinches…

explanation.definitionFit: Small cuts in a surface are notches; as a verb it is slang for steals or arrests.

clue.text: … Then S.R.N. gets weaving and builds up our vigour

indicators.note: weaving means interlacing threads, so these letters are interwoven anew

explanation.surface: A registered nurse takes up weaving as therapy to restore our health.
explanation.walkthrough: S.R.N. was a State Registered Nurse in Britain. 'weaving' rearranges THEN SRN GETS.
explanation.definitionFit: Making stronger or more robust is to fortify, building vigour.
